provenance.source: frozen blind prediction v1 of 'driver_free_z' (configuration 'driver_free'), Monte Carlo envelope of 200 Latin-hypercube runs (seed 20260925) over the tolerances of: driver_Re_ohm, driver_Mms_g, driver_Sd_cm2, driver_compliance_factor, driver_Bl_factor, driver_Rms_factor; protocol 'Open reference cup: measurement session (spec Section 17)'

notes: Columns: frequency_Hz; nominal, median, p5, p10, p90, p95, min, max in ohm; nominal, median, p5, p95, min, max of the phase in degrees; runs (successful Monte Carlo runs); shading (validity of the nominal solve: 0 none, 1 light, 2 dark; docs/netlist.md). Percentiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default). Bare driver in free air, before assembly. Overrides: {"drive_mW":0.01,"fidelity":1,"load":"driver_free_air","source_impedance_ohm":0}. Hang the driver by its leads at least 30 cm from any surface, diaphragm vertical. Re-hang it between repeats.
